diseases.name: Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions on leaves with gray centers, collar rot, and neck rot leading to broken panicles.
diseases.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer, use resistant varieties, and maintain proper water levels.

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae)
diseases.symptoms: Wavy yellow-to-white stripes on leaf margins starting from tips, leaf wilting (kresek stage).
diseases.prevention: Secure balanced NPK application, avoid field flooding from infected source, and clip leaf tips before transplanting.
diseases.pesticide: Spray Streptocycline @ 6g + Copper Oxychloride @ 300g per acre.

diseases.name: Turcicum Leaf Blight
diseases.symptoms: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions on leaves, starting from lower leaves moving upwards.
diseases.prevention: Crop rotation with legumes, destroy crop debris, and plant early during season.

diseases.name: Maydis Leaf Blight
diseases.symptoms: Small, rectangular lesions bounded by leaf veins, turning tan or straw-colored.
diseases.prevention: Clean cultivation, resistant hybrids, and proper weed management.

diseases.name: Stem Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina)
diseases.symptoms: Brownish-black spots on the stem, stem splitting, and dark pycnidia forming on lesions.
diseases.prevention: Ensure good drainage, avoid acidic soils, apply potash, and treat seeds with Carbendazim.

diseases.name: Boll Rot Complex
diseases.symptoms: Dark brown water-soaked lesions on bolls, bolls turning black and failing to open.
diseases.prevention: Avoid high dense planting, remove weeds, and secure proper aeration in canopy.
diseases.pesticide: Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 600g + Streptocycline @ 10g per acre.

diseases.name: Fusarium Wilt
diseases.symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of leaves, browning of internal vascular tissues (vascular discoloration).
diseases.prevention: Grow wilt-resistant cultivars, rotate with sorghum, and apply organic compost.
diseases.pesticide: Soil drenching with Carbendazim @ 1g/L near root zones.

diseases.name: Bud Rot (Phytophthora palmivora)
diseases.symptoms: Rotting of the central spindle leaf, foul smell, yellowing of younger leaves.
diseases.prevention: Clean crown regularly, cut and burn severely infected trees, and improve drainage.
diseases.pesticide: Apply Bordeaux paste on the cut surface or spray Bordeaux mixture 1%.

diseases.name: Papaya Ringspot Virus (PRSV)
diseases.symptoms: Mottle and mosaic patterns on leaves, dark green streaks on petioles, ringspots on fruits.
diseases.prevention: Control aphid vectors using yellow sticky traps, rogue infected plants, and plant barriers.
diseases.pesticide: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 2ml/L to control aphid vector populations.

diseases.name: Citrus Canker (Xanthomonas citri)
diseases.symptoms: Raised, corky, brown lesions on leaves, twigs, and fruits, surrounded by a yellow halo.
diseases.prevention: Prune infected twigs before monsoon, spray windbreaks, and use disease-free budwood.

diseases.name: Apple Scab (Venturia inaequalis)
diseases.symptoms: Olive-green to brown velvety spots on leaves and scabby lesions on fruits leading to cracking.
diseases.prevention: Clear fallen leaves in autumn, prune canopy for airflow, and apply urea spray to leaves on ground.
diseases.pesticide: Spray Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 100ml/acre or Captan 50% WP @ 400g/acre.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.symptoms: White powdery growth on both surfaces of leaf, leaf chlorosis, and premature drying.
diseases.prevention: Remove crop residues, avoid high humidity around canopy, and use drip irrigation.

diseases.name: Downy Mildew (Pseudoperonospora)
diseases.symptoms: Angular yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces, purple-gray mold on the underside of leaves.
diseases.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation, secure spacing, and use resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Anthracnose (Bird's Eye Rot)
diseases.symptoms: Sunken dark spots on shoots, circular spots with gray centers and dark borders on berries.
diseases.prevention: Prune out infected canes during dormancy, burn prunings, and keep canopy open.

diseases.name: Anthracnose (Colletotrichum)
diseases.symptoms: Dark brown tear-stain spots on fruits, blossom blight, and leaf spots.
diseases.prevention: Prune dry twigs, carry out post-harvest hot water treatment, and avoid canopy crowding.

diseases.name: Sigatoka Leaf Spot
diseases.symptoms: Narrow dark brown streaks on leaves, merging to form large dry necrotic zones.
diseases.prevention: Remove infected leaves regularly, secure drainage, and keep weeds down.
diseases.pesticide: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L + mineral oil or Carbendazim.

diseases.name: Bacterial Blight (Oily Spot)
diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked dark spots on leaves, stems, and fruits, cracking of fruit skin in L-shape.
diseases.prevention: Sterilize pruning tools, use pathogen-free cuttings, and avoid pruning in rainy weather.

diseases.name: Rust (Uromyces viciae-fabae)
diseases.symptoms: Orange-brown pustules on leaves and stems, leaf drop, and poor seed development.
diseases.prevention: Avoid early sowing, destroy weed hosts, and rotate with non-legumes.

diseases.name: Yellow Mosaic Disease (YMV)
diseases.symptoms: Bright yellow patches on leaves, leaf crumpling, and reduced pod count.
diseases.prevention: Rogue infected plants, sow resistant varieties, and control whiteflies.
diseases.pesticide: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 100ml/acre to manage vector insect populations.

diseases.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot
diseases.symptoms: Sub-circular brown spots with reddish-purple borders on leaves.
diseases.prevention: Rotate crops, destroy plant debris, and use seed treatment.

diseases.name: Seedling Wilt & Root Rot
diseases.symptoms: Sudden wilting of seedlings, black discoloration of roots, stem rot near soil line.
diseases.prevention: Seed treatment with Trichoderma, ensure proper soil aeration, avoid waterlogging.

diseases.name: Anthracnose (Colletotrichum)
diseases.symptoms: Dark red to black lesions on leaf veins, sunken spots on pods with dark margins.
diseases.prevention: Use certified clean seed, avoid working in wet fields, and burn crop debris.

diseases.name: Wilt (Fusarium udum)
diseases.symptoms: Gradual yellowing and wilting of plants, black streaks on wood under bark of stems.
diseases.prevention: Rotate with sorghum, apply Trichoderma viride to soil, and grow resistant cultivars.
diseases.pesticide: Seed treatment with Carbendazim + Thiram @ 2g/kg seed.

diseases.name: Ascochyta Blight
diseases.symptoms: Circular spots on leaves and pods with dark brown margins and pycnidia arranged in rings.
diseases.prevention: Intercrop with barley/mustard, use clean seeds, and destroy field stubble.

diseases.name: Coffee Leaf Rust (Hemileia vastatrix)
diseases.symptoms: Yellow-orange powdery spots on the lower surface of leaves, leaf drop, and dieback.
diseases.prevention: Maintain proper shade, apply organic compost, and spray Bordeaux mixture before monsoon.
